bio: A modern, minimalist-style restaurant located close to the beach which has turned its modest appearance into a real virtue. The focus here is on contemporary cuisine with traditional roots that ticks almost every box on its menu (fish and traditionally caught tuna, Spanish meat, rice dishes etc) and which makes use of the very best ingredients from Cádiz province along with touches of fusion influence. The traditional, country-style croquettes (either ham, or cheese and spinach) are a must, while the attractive guestrooms are an added bonus....
